50492072.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human poly His-tagged WDR5 (1 to 334 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3)-V2R-pRARE2 cells by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Analysis. SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. Human WDR5 (residues 1–334) was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The immobilization level was approximately 1000 response units (RU). The running buffer was 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% P20, 0.005% Tween 20. Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The flow rate was 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 Evaluation Software. The binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
